rag.text:
Test: TC-3940 — Feature area - Box scope - Own scope definition - Checking Filter Webhooks Event
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-25 Feature area - Box scope - Own scope definition
Labels: teamextplatform

Steps:
1. Navigate to Jira Filters -> click "Create Filter" button
   Expected: New filter is created
2. Being in newly created filter In Project field click Project -> All and choose projectName
   Data: projectName: TC-3940 Feature area - Box scope - Own scope definition - Checking Filter Webhooks Event
   Expected: Three issue appear:
- Bug
- Task
- Story
3. Click Save us button and fill up filterName
   Data: filterName: 3940 test
   Expected: Filter 3940 test is created in Jira
4. Navigate to boxName -> Box Configuration -> Scope Definition -> and add filterName
   Data: boxName: TC-3940 Feature area - Box scope - Own scope definition - Checking Filter Webhooks Event
filterName: 3940 test
   Expected: Filter is added to the scope
3 tasks in the scope is visible in scope definition window
5. Open Gantt module of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-3940 Feature area - Box scope - Own scope definition - Checking Filter Webhooks Event
   Expected: Three issues are visible in WBS:
- Bug
- Task
- Story
6. Open webhooks.log and verify if webhook "filter_created" is logged
   Data: Verify webhooks log in GCP or Kibana
   Expected: "filter_created" webhook is logged
7. Click in Jira Filters -> and open filterName
   Data: filterName: 3940 test
   Expected: Filter 3940 test is opened.
Three issue appear:
- Bug
- Task
- Story
8. Click in "type" and choose Bug.
Click Save button
   Expected: Only Bug is visible in filter
9. Open webhooks.log and verify if webhook "filter_updated" is logged
   Expected: "filter_updated" webhook is logged
10. Open Gantt module of boxName and refresh the page
   Data: boxName: TC-3940 Feature area - Box scope - Own scope definition - Checking Filter Webhooks Event
   Expected: 1 issue "Bug" is visible in WBS
11. Click in Jira Filters -> View all filters and delete filterName
   Data: filterName: 3940 test
   Expected: filter 3940 test is deleted from Jira
12. Open webhooks.log and verify if webhook "filter_deleted" is logged
   Expected: "filter_deleted" webhook is logged
13. Open Gantt module of boxName and refresh the page
   Expected: The scope is corrupted massage appear. 
The warning log with message appear:
- Error in scope for Jira:FolLowing elements: ID (jira_filter) are unavailable for plugin or inaccessible by Scope Owner
